long_biography.plain_text:
Mark Thomas Raymond Bailey established the business that became The Trade Centre Group as a Welsh used-car retailer. He developed a car-supermarket model built around high-volume sourcing, vehicle preparation and value-focused sales, then carried the format into English regional markets.

The group later added consumer-finance brokerage and a vehicle-buying service around its retail network. Bailey has moved between chairman and vice-chairman roles as professional executives assumed operating leadership, but he remains a director. Through Bailey Family Investments, the parent company he controls, he also retains the decisive ownership interest in the automotive platform he founded.
